description: A provenance-bound role overlay on immutable STRUCT-2K regional labels.

CONTINUATION.definition: Citation content broken across lines or too incomplete to establish an entry alone.

ENTRY_ANCHOR.definition: A recognizable bibliographic record that supplies independent entry evidence.

FILLER.definition: A separator, Markdown/table rule, OCR fragment, or other non-citation layout material included only inside a confirmed bibliography region.

HEADER.definition: An overall bibliography or references heading.

NON_BIB.definition: Ordinary material outside the bibliography region, including citation-heavy prose.

SUBHEADER.definition: An internal language, source, or category subdivision inside a bibliography.

UNKNOWN.definition: Insufficient evidence, unusable extraction, or unresolved reviewer disagreement.

boundary_flags.HARD_STOP: A line or physical gap that must terminate block growth.
boundary_flags.SOFT_STOP: Evidence against block growth that requires contextual confirmation.

label_statuses.ADJUDICATED: A trusted resolution based on preserved independent review evidence.
label_statuses.PROVISIONAL: A deterministic or model-derived bootstrap label; never independent evaluation truth.
label_statuses.SINGLE_REVIEW: One contextual review; eligible for development diagnostics only.
label_statuses.UNRESOLVED: Disagreement or insufficient evidence; masked from supervised losses.

invariants: The original regional label and block identity are immutable.
Only ENTRY_ANCHOR may seed a bibliography block.
HEADER and SUBHEADER may attach only to an independently confirmed entry region.
FILLER may bridge an interior anchored gap but may not seed or extend an outer boundary.
Model-only PROVISIONAL labels are never counted as independent evaluation truth.
UNKNOWN and UNRESOLVED examples are masked from every supervised loss.
